spans.s:
m. (-शः)
1 A mountainous country to the north of

India.
2

A native of that country, considered as a degraded Kṣatriya.
f. (-शा)
A kind of perfume, commonly Mura.

r. 1st cl. (खषति)
To kill, to hurt or injure.

m. (-सः)
1 Itch, scab.
2 A man of a country or tribe considered to be a degraded Kṣatriya: the Khasas inhabit the mountains surrounding Kashmir.
f. (-सा)
The mother of the imps or goblins.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Resting or dwelling in the air.
E.
ख, and शी to sleep, अच् aff.

n. (-रं)
A celestial or immortal body.
E.
ख, and शरीर body.

m. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Of a heavenly body.
E.
खशरीर, and इनि aff.

m. (-टः)
The Khaliśa, a kind of fish: see खलेश.

m. (-सः)
Air or wind.
E.
ख the atmosphere, and श्वास breath.

n. (-ष्पं)
1 Anger, passion.
2 Violence, oppression.
E.
खन to hurt, to dig, प Uṇādi affix, न changed to ष.

m. (-न्धः)
A plant, commonly Kṣīrakañcuki.

m. (-मः)
A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint.
E.
ख heaven, and सम equal, the same.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Produced in the sky, aerial, ethereal.
E.
ख. and सम्भव birth.

m. (-णः)
One of the Buddhas or Buddha saints.
n. (-णं)
Gliding through the air.
E.
ख heaven, and सर्पण who goes to or in.

m. (-जः)
An imp or goblin.
E.
खसा the mother of these beings, आत्मज a son.

f. (-नी)
The earth.
E.
ख ether, स्तन a breast, affix ङीष्.

m. (-सः)
The poppy.

m. (-सः)
Poppy juice, opium.
E.
खस्खस, and रस juice.

m. (-कः)
1 Crystal, the sun gem.
2 The moon gem: see सूर्य्यकान्त, and चन्द्रकान्त.
E.
ख heaven, and स्फटिक crystal.

m. (-शिः)
Name of a country to the east of Bengal: the Cossya hills; also खाशिक m. (-कः).

f. (-री)
A plant: see कश्मरी.
